budgets.qualification: Per-test and UI budgets are unchanged. Parent monotonic clocks are outside child Date mocks. Outer135s deadline permits only bounded4s failure cleanup; no later phase after timeout. Full raw output is retained; exceeding bound fails, without truncating to manufacture pass. Synchronous filesystem calls are not kernel-preempted by the timer; monotonic elapsed checks refuse a late PASS. The60s phase bound covers original child close/EOF observation; outer135s covers remaining control work before final admission. The absolute monotonic outer cutoff is checked synchronously immediately before scope creation, every source materialization, RED-to-GREEN transition, fixed-controls open/write, and every child spawn; a pending timer callback cannot admit a later phase. Cleanup stores one original start/deadline on the original active process; exceptional reentry uses only its remaining interval and never replays a TERM/KILL attempt.

evidence.source: Complete directory/file census and identities before/after each phase, before/after only allowed controls mutation, and final. Files regular/nlink1/mode0644; directories0755; no extra source path. Parent-control whole census must remain byte/stat-identical. evidence.process: Original detached POSIX group/session and leader start captured. Poll full group/session census; complete observed owned Node process identities retained. Known original zombies retain prior exact identity; unowned/unknown observations refuse. Success requires original ordinary close/EOF, exact exit/no signal, group/session empty and all recorded original PID/start identities absent. Complete per-sample rows are retained before validation; failure cleanup preserves its entire initial census, every unowned row/error and the full observed original identity map before clearing the active handle.
evidence.failureCleanup: Only original recorded same-start/same-session/group processes are signalled. TERM then KILL under4s; source/control failure censuses and remaining original processes are retained. Any triggered cleanup remains INCOMPLETE even if processes exit. Cleanup complete identities are preserved in finally even if cleanup throws; any continuation records its invocation against the same absolute original deadline and signal-attempt state.
evidence.limitations: This is sampled ownership/absence of the admitted finite Node group, not continuous kernel executable custody or broad native/process qualification. No source/script tests execute before gates.
